text: Now let's go through every step of creating your first invoice in the ByggExp app.
Choose Send an invoice or offer – the app guides you step by step.
First, fill in your company details. They then appear on every invoice and offer, so you only enter them once.
Save – and the first step is done.
Next, we add a client. It can be a private person or a business – here it's a business.
Only the company name is required, but everything you fill in appears neatly on the invoice.
You can also add the address, email and phone.
Then set the payment terms, currency and hourly rate – they apply to every invoice for this client.
The client is saved and stays in the system. Next time, you just select it – and all details are filled in on the invoice automatically.
In the next step, we create an article – what you sell, for example concrete work.
Choose the VAT rate, and the article is saved so you can use it on all future invoices.
Now we create the invoice.
Select the client we created earlier. Payment terms, due date and your reference are filled in automatically.
Then select the project. The order reference comes from the project, and the project name goes into the description.
Select the article and enter the quantity.
The unit price comes from the client's hourly rate.
The system calculates everything automatically.
Tap Create and send.
Done – your first invoice has been sent!
The next invoice is even quicker – the client and the article are already there.
